# Credit Risk Assessment and Collateral Monitoring

This document outlines critical actions for managing credit risk and collateral within the bank.

## Key Action Items:

*   Monitor the collateral value for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate the default risk quarterly.
*   Optimize the borrower credit score urgently.
*   Update the collateral value standard.
